author: (Nardo, 1827)

note.en: A heavy, high-finned coastal shark of sandy shelves and bays, listed by FishBase for Costa Rica; we found no local record, though the species is known from the Caribbean.
note.es: Un tiburón costero robusto, de aletas altas, de plataformas arenosas y bahías, listado por FishBase para Costa Rica; no encontramos registros locales, aunque la especie se conoce del Caribe.

evidence: No local record found; FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic (coast not stated)

sources.t: IUCN Red List: Carcharhinus plumbeus, Endangered

recWhy: No record on Costa Rica's Caribbean coast in the file (general range or Costa Rica only).
